teaser: When did you last say no to a deal that felt right in every column except the one that mattered? You carry life path 8, reached through the compound number 26, the total of your birth date added together before it reduces to a single digit, and 26 carries the name partnership. Set that beside an ISTJ's habit of checking the fine print twice before signing anything, and the week can start to look less like ambition and more like ledger-keeping done by hand, line by line, with the receipts kept long after anyone asked for them.
